title: ticket-envelope v1
description: The unit of work on the bus. Carried as a JSON block in a GitHub issue, pull request, or comment. Consumers fail-safe refuse any unknown grammar or version (P7).

id.description: owner/repo#number — the GitHub issue or PR carrying this ticket.

kind.description: objective-lock: lock a project's 00-OBJECTIVE.md. work: a unit of build/iterate. verdict-request: asks the host for a tier-2 verdict. refresh-arm: arms a component refresh. review: a ship-gate review.

pair.description: Pair identity this ticket belongs to (the genesis pair is 'box'). Authority is per-pair.

session.description: Owning session namespace. All mutable local state for this ticket is namespaced under it (P6).

scope.description: Declared repository set (owner/repo) the session may touch for this ticket. Isolation is by scope, code-enforced.

sha.description: Exact head sha the ticket is bound to. Required for verdict-request and refresh-arm.
